Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Artistry by Design specializes in creating and selling original artwork, including paintings, digital art, and textile crafts. Our studio prioritizes safety and artistry by using non-toxic materials and maintaining a clean, organized workspace. We host small public workshops focused on painting and crafts, ensuring all safety protocols are followed. Additionally, we have implemented secure inventory management and fire safety measures, including smoke alarms and a sprinkler system, to protect our creative space and valuable art.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 15, 2023, a minor water leak occurred in the studio due to heavy rain, causing damage to some art supplies and inventory. The estimated loss amount was $1,200. The claim was submitted, and the situation has been resolved with repairs completed and all necessary items replaced. The status is closed.
